fact: In late June 2026 the national fibre optic network reached Wau and crossed into Western Equatoria State towards Tambura, a year after the government's Fiber Optic Implementation Steering Committee, chaired by the Deputy Minister of ICT and Postal Services, approved more than US$9 million for the design phase in June 2025; no county or state office is said to be connected to it.
title: Western Equatoria Governor Welcomes Fiber Optic Progress
